attributes.name: Deathtrap in a Jar
attributes.powers:
Banish this card to add 1d6 and the Piercing or Slashing trait to a combat check by a character at your location, or to add 1 die to a Disable check by a character at your location.

Banish this card to explore your location. During this exploration, add 1 die to your Disable checks.

After playing this card, you may succeed at a Craft 10 check; then discard a card that has the Alchemical trait to recharge this card instead of banishing it.
